issues.description: The problem statement for Aufgabe 07 requires Gemeinden with more than 75,000 male or female inhabitants, but the solution uses a threshold of 7,500 (WHERE einwohner_m > 7500 OR einwohner_w > 7500). This numeric mismatch between the specification and the provided solution will confuse students about the correct cutoff and cause tests or expected results to disagree with the example solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the numeric threshold between specification and solution. Either update the solution to use 75000 (WHERE einwohner_m > 75000 OR einwohner_w > 75000) to match the problem statement, or change the problem statement to request 7,500 if that was intended.
